title: quicksort partition drops duplicates
description: This quicksort should return a sorted list preserving all elements including duplicates. The bug partitions into strictly-less and strictly-greater buckets and appends only a single pivot, silently dropping other elements equal to the pivot.

hidden_tests.test_qsort.py:
from qsort import quicksort


def test_quicksort():
    assert quicksort([3, 1, 2]) == [1, 2, 3]
    assert quicksort([5, 3, 5, 1, 3, 5]) == [1, 3, 3, 5, 5, 5]
    assert quicksort([2, 2, 2]) == [2, 2, 2]
    assert quicksort([]) == []
    assert quicksort([1]) == [1]
